pages.title: Engineering, end to end
pages.lead: Product development across embedded electronics, desktop software, web, Android, automation, networking and prototyping.
pages.html:
PROFESSIONAL PROFILE

Engineer and developer working since 2014 (12+ years), spanning embedded systems, PCB design, automation and PC software. Work includes sensor products, industrial controllers, telemetry devices, motor-control electronics and engineering utilities. Recent work adds websites and Android applications for private AI systems.

Experience: IT engineer at Adventx and Tesla-service, plus freelance projects.

CORE CAPABILITIES

01 EMBEDDED
STM32 (F0–F7, G0/G3/G4), ESP32, AVR; C/C++; peripherals, drivers and integration.
02 ELECTRONICS
Schematics, multilayer PCBs, prototyping, design reviews and enclosure CAD.
03 CONNECTIVITY
CAN, Modbus RTU, RS-485, UART, USB, SPI, I²C, Ethernet, TCP/UDP, BLE and GSM.
04 SOFTWARE
Desktop apps: C# (WinForms, WPF), Qt/C++, GTK, Swift; Python, Bash, diagnostics and automation.
05 WEB & MOBILE
Fast static websites, web interfaces and admin panels (HTML/CSS/JS, Cloudflare); Android apps in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
06 DELIVERY
Device configuration, troubleshooting, testing tools, technical documentation and visual instructions.

pages.title: Touchscreen control unit
pages.lead: Recent physical prototype photographed in November 2026.
pages.html:
CUSTOM DEVICE

A compact, enclosed control system with an integrated color touchscreen, large numerical readouts, preset selection, start control and run statistics.

The photographed interface displays time, speed, preset navigation and status. The enclosure appears custom-made; its internal circuitry and firmware specifications are not established by the available photograph.

DESIGN FOCUS Human-machine interface · Enclosure integration · Device-level controls

pages.title: Controller in 3D
pages.lead: Two generations of the touchscreen control unit as web-ready 3D models (GLB), exported from the original Blender project; the renders below come from those GLB files.
pages.html:
MODELS FOR THE WEB

Lightweight GLB models (about 150 KB each) with PBR materials, the screen texture taken from a photo of the real unit; they plug into the interactive 3D product gallery on viteh.org.

SKILLS · Blender / glTF / WebGL

FROM CAD TO PRODUCT PAGE

The path from the enclosure design and PCB project (KiCad, Blender) to an interactive model that visitors can rotate, without third-party viewers or tracking.

SKILLS · enclosure CAD / 3D pipeline / web

pages.title: Sensors & automation
pages.lead: Selected projects documented with original product and system images.
pages.html:
GREENHOUSE CONTROLLER

Controller for opening and closing greenhouse screens, with a local display and associated control electronics. The original project archive includes connection illustrations and a video guide.

DMM-T2 SENSOR MODULE

Temperature and humidity data acquisition modules with Modbus RTU communication, including variants for thermocouple inputs and different mechanical layouts.

pages.title: Custom hardware platforms
pages.lead: Original board imagery from previous hardware development projects.
pages.html:
MULTI-LAYER MOTION CONTROL

Designed a four-layer controller board for TMC5130A stepper motor drivers as part of a customer 3D-printing project; also developed basic motor-control firmware. Additional expansion-board work addressed multi-motor systems.

OTHER BOARD WORK

I/O electronics, charging-station modules, GSM monitoring, and current ESP32-S3 gateway / Ethernet / RS-485 / CAN PCB work.

pages.title: Telemetry & remote monitoring
pages.lead: Field electronics designed to collect information, report status and integrate with operator systems.
pages.html:
GSM SENSOR LOGGER

Four sensor inputs, two relay outputs and backup power. The logger recorded sensor values and issued SMS alerts when configured thresholds were exceeded. It also uploaded data to a server for charting and remote configuration, with SMS-based commands.

ADDITIONAL CONNECTED PRODUCTS

Broadcast watchdog: GSM-based radio-audio monitoring with loss-of-broadcast alerts and remote audio listening.

Event logger: PIR event timestamps collected to a PC utility, tabular viewer and CSV export; enclosure produced with 3D printing.

pages.title: Tools that support hardware
pages.lead: Desktop control applications, diagnostic utilities and cross-platform engineering workflows.
pages.html:
DESKTOP TOOLS

C# software for sensor configuration and control, serial-port communication, Modbus analysis, CAN packet inspection and device diagnostics. Includes custom user interfaces for engineering and service tasks.

pages.title: Websites & web interfaces
pages.lead: Fast, private, multilingual sites, with the tools to run them.
pages.html:
STATIC SITES, NO TRACKERS

Static, no-build sites without third-party requests (no CDN, fonts or analytics), built to be GDPR-friendly, with legal pages for Germany and light/dark themes.

SKILLS · web design / performance / privacy

CONTACT FORMS & INTEGRATIONS

Contact form with attachments served by a Cloudflare Worker and Email Routing, with spam protection and origin checks; hooks for mail and chat assistants.

SKILLS · Cloudflare Workers / forms / integrations

3D PRODUCT GALLERY

Interactive 3D models of hardware products (GLB exported from Blender), loaded lazily, one scene at a time, with a flat-image fallback.

SKILLS · 3D on the web / Blender / accessibility

PRIVATE ADMIN & TEMPLATES

A private admin for the site: switch sections on or off, edit texts in three languages, build pages from templates, preview, then publish.

SKILLS · admin tooling / content workflow

pages.title: Embedded Systems & HMI
pages.lead: Research, experiments and prototypes are part of my applied engineering expertise, not just future product ideas.
pages.html:
ESP32-S3 / LVGL GRAPHICAL INTERFACES

Implementation and evaluation of LVGL 9.x touchscreen user interfaces; display bring-up using CO5300, SH8601, NV3041A and ST7789 controllers; SPI/QSPI display integration, FT3168 touch and PSRAM constraints.

SKILLS · UI architecture / display drivers / HMI debugging

POWER MANAGEMENT & WIRELESS CONTROL

ESP32-C6 + ESP-NOW servo-control experiments with wake, transmission and sleep cycles. Evaluated deep-sleep and light-sleep behavior, power consumption, PWM control and responsiveness.

SKILLS · low-power design / telemetry / measurement

MCU PLATFORMS & BOARD BRING-UP

Experience exploring STM32 and ESP32 alongside RISC-V and Linux-capable boards including Milk-V Duo, LicheeRV Nano and RK3506-based hardware. Evaluated peripheral capabilities and development workflows.

SKILLS · platform evaluation / firmware integration

EDGE HARDWARE & PCB ARCHITECTURE

Design investigation of connected microcontroller boards with CAN, RS-485, Ethernet, digital I/O and sensor interfaces; experience considering board layout, interoperability and physical integration.

SKILLS · schematics / interface selection / prototyping

pages.title: Linux, Networks & Diagnostics
pages.lead: Hands-on system integration, debugging, protocol analysis and real-device experimentation.
pages.html:
LINUX / OPENWRT NETWORKING

Configured and investigated OpenWrt gateways, virtualized routers, IPv4 routing, LAN bridges, Tailscale subnet routing, Cloudflare Tunnel and remote management workflows.

SKILLS · networking / firewall logic / remote access

SINGLE-BOARD COMPUTERS & SERVICES

Raspberry Pi and embedded Linux platform investigations: storage and boot planning, SSH, services, Docker-based workflows and device-oriented Linux automation.

SKILLS · Linux administration / Bash / systems integration

AUTOMOTIVE CAN BUS & DIAGNOSTICS

Practical Toyota Prius hybrid-battery repair and diagnostic work with CANable V2, Python-CAN, ECU request/response traffic, battery-block voltage and regeneration/load measurements.

SKILLS · CAN / diagnostics / data interpretation / hardware repair

DESKTOP & DEVICE INTEGRATION

Experience solving hardware/software integration problems across Linux and Windows, including device interfaces, remote desktop, printing services, USB, serial tools and firmware processes.

SKILLS · troubleshooting / integration / automation

pages.title: Local AI & GPU Engineering
pages.lead: Applied investigations that developed demonstrable technical knowledge in model deployment and heterogeneous computing.
pages.html:
LOCAL LLM DEPLOYMENT

Hands-on operation and testing of coding and general-purpose local models, including GGUF quantized deployments. Compared model quality, quantization, memory footprint and latency trade-offs.

SKILLS · inference deployment / benchmarking / evaluation

AMD ROCm / MEMORY MANAGEMENT

Troubleshot ROCm model-loading behavior on an AMD unified-memory system, including mmap versus mlock loading, memory limits and model residency. Documented successful tool-call tests in personal experiments.

SKILLS · ROCm / runtime debugging / memory profiling

MULTI-GPU / EXPERT PLACEMENT

Explored NVIDIA and AMD compute configurations, GPU VRAM limits, CPU/GPU offload, MoE active-expert placement, partitioning and the potential impact on inference throughput.

SKILLS · hardware-aware optimization / performance analysis

AI-ASSISTED ENGINEERING WORKFLOWS

Experimented with local coding assistants, tool-calling reliability, scripting, Git-based workflows and repeatable technical checks for embedded and software development.

SKILLS · developer tooling / validation / agent workflows
